name: Monstera Deliciosa
wateringGuidance: Let the top 5 cm of soil dry; empty the saucer after watering.
soil: Chunky potting mix with bark and perlite
fertilizer: Monthly at half strength in spring and summer
description: A sculptural tropical climber whose mature leaves develop beautiful splits and windows.
careTips: Support climbing stems with a moss pole.
Rotate the pot a quarter turn weekly.
Wipe broad leaves with a damp cloth.

name: Snake Plant
wateringGuidance: Let soil dry completely; use less water in cool, darker months.
soil: Fast-draining cactus mix with extra perlite
description: Architectural upright leaves make this resilient succulent a quiet statement in any room.
careTips: Keep water out of the leaf rosette.
Avoid oversized pots.
Protect from cold window glass.

name: Golden Pothos
wateringGuidance: Water when the upper 3–5 cm of potting mix feels dry.
fertilizer: Monthly at half strength during active growth
description: A generous trailing vine with heart-shaped leaves brushed with gold.
careTips: Trim just above a node for fuller growth.
Give variegated leaves enough indirect light.
Guide vines onto a support or let them trail.

name: Spider Plant
wateringGuidance: Allow the top 2–3 cm to dry, then water thoroughly.
fertilizer: Every 4–6 weeks at half strength in spring and summer
description: Arching striped leaves and dangling plantlets bring movement to shelves and hanging pots.
careTips: Try low-mineral water if tips brown.
Let baby plants develop roots before separating.
Avoid heavy feeding and salt buildup.

name: Peace Lily
wateringGuidance: Check the top 2 cm; keep lightly moist but never waterlogged.
fertilizer: Every 6–8 weeks at half strength in growing season
description: Glossy dark foliage surrounds elegant white spathes in a sheltered, softly lit spot.
careTips: Do not wait for severe wilting to water.
Remove spent flower stalks at the base.
Keep away from heating and cooling vents.

name: ZZ Plant
wateringGuidance: Let the mix dry throughout; rhizomes store water.
soil: Free-draining potting mix with coarse perlite
description: Glossy feather-like stems and water-storing rhizomes suit a low-maintenance indoor garden.
careTips: Keep rhizomes above standing water.
Clean glossy leaflets gently.
Increase light gradually for stronger growth.

name: Chinese Evergreen
wateringGuidance: Allow the top 3 cm to dry before watering.
fertilizer: Every 6 weeks at half strength in spring and summer
description: Silver-patterned foliage brightens sheltered corners with soft, layered color.
careTips: Protect from temperatures below 15°C.
Avoid cold water on roots.
Choose brighter indirect light for patterned cultivars.

name: Rubber Plant
wateringGuidance: Allow the top 5 cm to dry; drain the pot completely.
soil: Potting mix amended with bark and perlite
fertilizer: Monthly at half strength during active growth
description: Bold, glossy oval leaves give this upright tropical tree its distinctive sculptural form.
careTips: Wipe leaves to remove dust.
Wear gloves when pruning irritating sap.
Keep the position stable; abrupt moves can cause leaf drop.

name: Boston Fern
wateringGuidance: Check frequently; keep evenly moist, never saturated.
soil: Rich, moisture-retentive but airy potting mix
fertilizer: Monthly at quarter strength in spring and summer
description: A fountain of delicate green fronds that thrives with consistent moisture and humidity.
careTips: Trim dry fronds at their base.
Use a humidifier in dry rooms.
Keep away from hot drafts.

name: Parlor Palm
wateringGuidance: Let the top 2–3 cm dry; never leave roots standing in water.
fertilizer: Every 6–8 weeks at half strength during active growth
description: Fine, feathery fronds bring a graceful tropical feeling to compact indoor spaces.
careTips: Do not cut the growing tip.
Inspect leaflet undersides for mites.
Keep out of harsh midday sun.

name: Calathea
wateringGuidance: Water when the top 1–2 cm begins to dry; avoid complete drying.
soil: Moisture-retentive mix with bark and perlite
fertilizer: Every 6–8 weeks at quarter strength in growing season
description: Rounded leaves with painterly silver-green stripes reward attentive care and humid air.
careTips: Prefer rainwater or low-mineral filtered water.
Keep humidity steady.
Avoid direct sun and cold drafts.

name: Aloe Vera
wateringGuidance: Let soil dry completely and drain well; reduce watering in winter.
fertilizer: Once or twice during spring and summer
description: A sun-loving succulent with thick, water-storing leaves arranged in a clean rosette.
careTips: Acclimate gradually to direct sun.
Keep water out of the crown.
Use a pot with generous drainage.

name: Philodendron
wateringGuidance: Let the top 3–5 cm dry before soaking and draining.
soil: Airy potting mix with bark and perlite
fertilizer: Monthly at half strength during active growth
description: A forgiving climbing vine with rich green, heart-shaped leaves.
careTips: Pinch growing tips for bushier vines.
Offer a climbing support.
Keep cut stems away from pets.

name: English Ivy
wateringGuidance: Let the surface dry slightly; avoid both drought and soggy soil.
fertilizer: Monthly at half strength in spring and summer
description: Classic lobed leaves trail elegantly in a cool, bright indoor position.
careTips: Favor a cool room with good airflow.
Check regularly for spider mites.
Prune long vines to maintain shape.

name: Areca Palm
wateringGuidance: Water when the upper 3 cm is dry; do not let the pot sit in water.
fertilizer: Every 6–8 weeks with a diluted palm fertilizer in growing season
description: Soft, arching fronds and golden canes create a generous indoor canopy.
careTips: Avoid high-mineral water when possible.
Remove only fully brown fronds.
Give the canopy room and bright filtered light.
